verdict.rationale: The quickstart states the free plan includes 3 agents with no card required. Onboarding is self-serve: install the CLI from npm, mint your own API key, and deploy a template in under 5 minutes, with no sales contact mentioned. Billing is a self-serve flat subscription with set agent counts. Missing for 10: detailed free-tier limits beyond the agent count (e.g., whether the default metered LLM access is included on the free plan), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the signup flow.
